caption: Watch this video if you suffer from high blood pressure #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #chinesemedicineworks #healthy
transcript: Which food raises insulin more, beef or pasta? The answer may surprise you, my friend. Most people know that insulin controls blood sugar. What fewer people know is that high insulin is also the root of weight gain, high blood pressure and deep fatigue. We are taught that carbs raise insulin. This is true. But protein also raises insulin, even when it does not raise blood sugar at all. Beef raises insulin more than pasta does. This is not a small difference. The body responds to rich protein the same way it responds to carbs. It calls for insulin. So what actually helps? Fiber. Fiber slows everything down. It gently lowers insulin. It gives the body room to find its balance. More protein is not always the answer. More fiber from simple whole foods often is. If this spoke to you, my book, The Body Remembers How to Eat, holds the complete path. It is linked in my bio.
